name: Cherry Works ~Boku ga Imouto o Daita Riyuu~
original_name: Cherry Works ～ボクが妹を抱いた理由～
source:
A guy went with his step sister to see about joining the art club. What they came upon were the club members having fun. To keep their secret, the club president decided to make the brother/sister's rumored close relationship closer. To do that, he will teach them how to have fun. How well he can do that will have different results.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050209185814/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
主人公陪没有血缘关系的妹妹参观美术社，准备考虑是否入社，却撞见社员们正在寻欢作乐。为保住秘密，社长决定让传言中本就亲密过头的兄妹真正更进一步，并亲自教导他们如何享乐。至于他能把两人调教到什么地步，将导向不同的结果。

[译自 [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050209185814/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
